title: Content Research and Slate
summary: Two new galaxies, Content Research and Slate, plus "Why this translation" on every translated line, cancel for Playground jobs, replace-or-keep uploads and cleaner deliverables in Projects, and QE reports that name what caused each error.

items.title: Research your market and plan content.
items.body: A research run reads your company profile and writes a report with content pillars, opportunities, campaigns and a bank of ideas. Ask follow-up questions for free. A run costs 20,000 credits and gets a short name when the report lands.

items.title: Company profiles.
items.body: Set up a profile from your homepage, read for free.

items.title: An idea bank.
items.body: Move ideas along a pipeline board, edit their title, hook and summary, archive and restore them, and hand one to Slate or Blog to make it.

items.title: A shared calendar.
items.body: Public holidays for each region, curated marketing days and dated moments, in month and agenda views.

items.title: Moments: what people are talking about now.
items.body: Off until you turn it on. It runs in 30-day periods at 6,000 credits each, renews automatically, and tells you 3 days before a renewal.

children.body: Listen with topic presets, keywords and RSS feeds.
Trends come from Google Trends, Google News, Wikipedia, Bluesky and Hacker News, scored for relevance, heat and brand safety.
Search trends live in up to 8 regions, and turn a moment into ideas.

items.title: Branded reports.
items.body: Download a report as a designed PDF or Word document in your brand kit's logo, colours and fonts, with a cover, an impact and effort matrix, campaigns, follow-up answers and sources. Markdown is still there too.

items.title: Notifications.
items.body: You're told when your research is ready or has failed, and when Moments pauses.

items.title: Work with an AI creative director.
items.body: Start a board from a brief or a Content Research idea. The director kicks off with concepts, then you chat, push it further and pick favourites. A board costs 10,000 credits.

items.title: Concepts you can see.
items.body: Each concept has a palette, type and web and social previews, plus key visuals. A board includes 25 images, and extra images cost 300 credits each.

items.title: One-page briefs.
items.body: Write a brief with a live preview, download it as a PDF (Devanagari, Arabic, CJK, Cyrillic and Greek print correctly) or save it to Assets.

children.body: Stop a running turn (except the opening one).
Edit the board's brand kit, notes, prompt and references after it opens.
Review held images before generating them.
Archive a board and restore it later. Archived boards are read-only.

items.title: See why a translation reads the way it does.
items.body: For VitraTM memories, a **Why** drawer shows who decided the wording (a memory match or the AI model), what the model was shown, what was left out and why, and which words came from a term or a reference. It also says when a person has edited it since.

items.title: Open it wherever you see a translation.

children.body: Translation memory rows and the Translate dialog.
Translate Photo and Playground segment rows.

items.title: Translate Video lines explained in full.
items.body: A line reused from the memory says it was reused as is, a merged card shows one record per line, and a line translated moments ago says its record is still being saved.

items.title: Native-script keyboard in more places:
items.body: glossary entries, term-base concepts and the source text in **Translate & Add**.

items.title: Replace a file or keep both.
items.body: Uploading a file with the name of one already in the folder now asks. **Replace** keeps the file's place, task and links with the new content, and the next run re-runs that task. **Keep both** saves the new one as "name (2)".

items.title: Deliverables named by file and language.
items.body: Outputs are filed as source name, language code and extension (product-intro.de-DE.srt) in a folder per language, and subtitle text is filed too. Cancelling a re-run keeps the last good result.

items.title: Faster uploads and checklists.
items.body: Up to 4 files upload at once, empty files are left out with a message, and the tray counts files. Checklist items appear at once, and pasting a list adds one item per line.

items.title: See what failed and why.
items.body: The overview bar shows failed tasks in their own red segment, and the task drawer names the reason with a link to the run.

items.title: One set of project languages.
items.body: A workflow's language fields now set the project's languages, and Settings shows them read-only with a pointer to the Fields tab.

children.body: Saving custom fields asks before deleting a field and its values.
A target language the same as the source is refused.
An end date before the start date is refused.

items.body: The top bar and section tabs stay pinned on long pages.

items.title: Cancel a running job.
items.body: Document and text translations, text-to-speech, lip-sync and video processes can be cancelled. Credits are refunded if the job hadn't started yet and kept once work has begun. A cancelled job stays listed as Cancelled, to retry (charged again) or delete.

items.title: QE reports name what caused each error.
items.body: Each error carries its source (memory, term base, glossary, style guide, default rules or the AI model), with an **Issues by source** table and who translated each segment, in the app and in the PDF.

items.title: A cleaner QE PDF.
items.body: It prints plain text instead of markup, uses the app's language names, and shows times in your time zone.

items.title: **Download PDF** saves the file directly.
items.body: Each download uses a private link that expires after 15 minutes.

items.title: Runs show when they last moved.
items.body: The runs list shows **Last updated** instead of Duration, and the run page header shows when it was updated.

items.title: Connect without leaving Universe.
items.body: A connect dialog explains what happens, then the service's own sign-in opens in a pop-up. If the pop-up is blocked or closed, it says so.

items.title: Many more services listed,
items.body: including Facebook, X, Pinterest, Shopify, Notion, Figma, Canva, Salesforce, Slack and Google Analytics. Services that aren't ready yet show as coming soon.

items.title: The top bar fits on a phone.
items.body: Below 640 px the switches show icons only, the credit balance is compact (1.5M), and the search pill is hidden, so the bell and account menu are always in reach.

items.title: Translate Video: re-translating an unchanged line cleared its audio,
items.body: so the editor said "No audio found". The line now keeps its audio and status.

items.title: QE scores counted markup as words.
items.body: Inline tags inflated the word count and the MQM score. Words are now counted on plain text. Earlier reports keep their counts until re-run.

items.title: Duplicate glossary and term-base entries said "Something went wrong".
items.body: They now say the term already exists.

items.title: Native-script typing could insert an older suggestion.
items.body: Pressing Space now commits only the suggestion for the word you typed, and Esc closes the suggestion list without closing the dialog.

items.title: Cancelling a Cosmos run left its jobs queued.
items.body: Its jobs now end with the run.

items.title: Large zip downloads could hang
items.body: with more than about 50 files. They now finish.

items.title: Undo after **Assign to me** in Cmd+K did nothing.
items.body: It now puts the task back as it was.

items.title: Older project tasks filed deliverables under a language name
items.body: such as french_france. They now use the language code (fr-FR).
